name: Sheet fill
description: A spreadsheet filling itself in: a selection ring steps down two columns as each value types into its cell, then a difference column fills top to bottom in green or red by sign, and a collaborator's ring and name tag settle on the last cell.

name: Sticky board
description: A dotted whiteboard where a hand-drawn road winds across from left to right behind a collaborator's cursor, sticky notes popping up at each stop with a day pill on the road, as the view pulls back from the first note to the whole plan.

name: Logo cloud
description: App tiles scattered in depth round a central hub, the near ones big and soft, the far ones small, each layer drifting toward the viewer at its own pace before every tile flies into the hub and it pulses: integrations, connectors or partners.

controls.l: Tiles (comma-separated names, up to 12; each shows its initials)

texts.name: labels
texts.label: Tiles (comma-separated names, up to 12; each shows its initials)

name: Selection frame
description: Two lines of a headline swinging in at a tilt, each caught in a design tool's selection box with corner handles and a collaborator's name tag, then straightening with a little overshoot before the boxes let go.

name: Presence cursors
description: A headline with collaborators' cursors drifting round it, each with a coloured name tag; one cursor drags a selection across the first word and types a new one in its place, up to twice, the rest of the line sliding to make room.

controls.l: Lead words, in turn (comma-separated, up to 3)

texts.name: words
texts.label: Lead words, in turn (comma-separated, up to 3)

name: Network bloom
description: A knowledge graph branching into being: a gold hub flares, cold blue comets shoot out along its spokes and land as pink nodes in a flash, each throwing out smaller comets that land as leaves, and the spokes warm from blue to gold as the graph settles; it holds, fades and blooms again, an intro for the live network.

name: Metric strip
description: A dashboard strip of up to four labelled metrics that counts up and then keeps ticking from one set of values to the next, a small green or red arrow showing which way each number moved and a light sweeping along the strip at every change.

controls.l: Values, one set per change (sets separated by semicolons, up to 5 sets of 4)

texts.name: states
texts.label: Values, one set per change (sets separated by semicolons, up to 5 sets of 4)

name: Branch menu
description: A glowing orb reaching out to a stack of category tiles: curves draw out one after another with a spark running along each, every tile flashing bright as its spark lands and settling as its count ticks up, then the chosen one lights up in gold with its curve.

controls.l: Values (comma-separated, up to 6; prefixes and suffixes kept)

texts.name: values
texts.label: Values (comma-separated, up to 6; prefixes and suffixes kept)

name: Colour blocks
description: Bands of flat colour sweep across in staggered rows, covering one picture and uncovering the next behind them. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Stretch text
description: A title whose letters are pulled tall along a cut line, the stretch travelling across the word in a wave, like type drawn on a variable-height axis.

name: Echo text
description: A title trailed by copies of its own outline in two alternating colours, fanning out behind it and folding back in a ripple. Set the outline width to 0 for solid stacked copies.

name: Photocopy
description: A picture run through a tired photocopier: hard black toner on off-white paper, clumped grain, pale streaks down the page, burnt edges and a slight shift with every copy, like a zine page.

name: Pixel stretch
description: A picture kept whole up to a line, then dragged out from it in long flat bars of its own edge colours, the line ragged and drifting.

name: Shape tiles
description: A grid of flat-coloured tiles, each holding a disc, quarter circle, half circle, diamond, ring or square that morphs into another and swaps colours on its own beat.

name: Concentric shapes
description: Flat-coloured shapes nested inside one another, growing out of the centre (or sinking into it) as they turn and morph between circle, squircle, flower and star.

controls.l: Shape (0 circle, 1 squircle, 2 flower, 3 star, 4 morphing)

name: Ribbon bands
description: Flat ribbons of clashing colour stacked across the frame, each edge riding its own slow wave so they overlap and part, with a soft shadow under every fold.

name: Stepped gradient
description: A three-colour gradient cut into flat steps, the edge between each pair broken into a ragged skyline of pixel stairs, swaying slowly.

name: Detail panel
description: A record's detail panel swinging in from the edge of the screen in perspective, then filling in from the top: a category and a typed title, a status badge and a button, a headline metric counting up over rising bars, a grid of four icon stats counting up, and an AI note; a sheen sweeps across it to finish.

controls.l: Stats (comma-separated, four; prefixes and suffixes kept)

name: Live network
description: A living knowledge graph: a gold hub throws glowing spokes out to pink branch nodes, each strung to a few small leaves, while sparks of light run along the links and nodes flare in turn; it slowly turns and keeps moving on a loop, a backdrop for a data or AI story.

name: Sentiment tile
description: A dashboard tile for a 0–100 score such as sentiment: the percentage counts up, a change badge slides in green or red by its sign, a mood chip (Negative, Moderate or Positive, picked from the score) pops in and tints the card, and a dot-matrix histogram rises column by column with the score's column lit.
